ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-1: Zero-price bypass via SqrtPriceCalculator.computeRatioX96 returning 0 on overflow
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: computeRatioX96 returns 0 only on arithmetic overflow of extreme inputs. validateHandlerOrder checks bounds (isSet && sqrtPriceX96 < minSqrtPriceX96 -> revert). A 0 return would fail the min bound check. Additionally, CLOBTransferHandler._enforceTokenHooks does not pass zero amounts. Edge cases (both-zero -> 2^96, amount1=0 -> MIN_SQRT_RATIO, amount0=0 -> MAX_SQRT_RATIO) are all handled.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-2: Direct handler call bypasses pricing enforcement in beforeSwap/afterSwap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOBTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer requires msg.sender == AMM (line 230). PermitTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer requires msg.sender == AMM (line 115). No executeSwap function exists on either handler. All settlement entry points are AMM-guarded. Forge test confirms revert for non-AMM callers.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-3: Settings sync gap - CLOBTransferHandler.setTokenSettings may leave stale memSettings in hook
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CreatorHookSettingsRegistry.setTokenSettings (line 376-378) stores memSettings with initialized=true, but syncs raw calldata settings to hooks (line 397). If caller passes initialized=false, hook gets initialized=false. However, _getOrFetchTokenSettings (line 907-918) self-heals: when initialized==false, it fetches from registry and stores corrected version. No value extraction path exists - only extra gas cost on first access after sync.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-4: Transient storage leak - beforeSwap writes to DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT but slot not cleared on all paths
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT is written in beforeSwap for direct swaps (poolType==address(0)) and read in afterSwap. Transient storage resets per transaction (EIP-1153). AMM always calls hooks in order (beforeSwap then afterSwap in same tx). If beforeSwap is disabled, no write occurs; if afterSwap reads stale/0, the price check may be incorrect but the slot was from the SAME transaction or is 0. This is the known CP-001/HOOK-001 pattern. No new exploitation vector.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H1: Forge permit with arbitrary feeOnTop (unsigned field) to drain extra tokens
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: feeOnTop is unsigned in SWAP_TYPEHASH but bounded by limitAmount. Input swaps: feeOnTop > amountIn reverts (FeeHelper.sol:53). Output swaps: feeOnTop added to amountIn, then amountIn > limitAmount reverts (AMMModule.sol:2171). Signer controls limitAmount (signed field). No unbounded drain possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H2: Spoof executor context to settle orders with wrong recipient
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Both CLOBTransferHandler and PermitTransferHandler require msg.sender == AMM for ammHandleTransfer. Executor is derived from msg.sender in AMMModule swap flow. Cannot be spoofed: EVM msg.sender integrity is guaranteed.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H3: Replay CLOB order with different nonce context
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOB orders use auto-incremented nonces (nextOrderNonce++). Each order gets unique nonce. closeOrder checks maker ownership. Nonces are monotonically increasing, no replay possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H4: Redirect fee to attacker address via hook configuration
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook fee configuration requires token owner/admin (LibOwnership check). Fee recipients don't affect signer's exposure because limitAmount bounds total cost. Attacker cannot profit: feeOnTop amount must be within limitAmount bounds.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H5: Cross-chain signature replay (missing chainId binding)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: EIP-712 domain separator includes chainId. PermitC handles domain separator construction. Different chains produce different digests. Same signature does not validate on different chain.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H6: Deploy ERC-1271 universal signer to bypass all signature checks
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: ERC-1271 contract can only sign for ITSELF. PermitC verifies signature against the from address. Attacker's ERC-1271 contract can only authorize spending its OWN tokens, not other users' tokens.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H7: Call flash-loan callback directly to get credited without providing capital
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Flash loan callback is to msg.sender only (AMM calls back to the flashLoan caller). Balance check after callback enforces repayment. No separate callback registration.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H8: tx.origin phishing to relay user identity
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Neither PermitTransferHandler nor CLOBTransferHandler use tx.origin. All access control uses msg.sender. Confirmed via code search.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H9: Forge cross-module caller context to bypass access control
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All module-crossing calls go through diamond proxy (delegatecall preserves msg.sender). External calls to handlers check msg.sender == AMM. EVM guarantees msg.sender integrity.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H10: Reuse permit signature with different from address to drain another user
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: The from address is part of the EIP-712 signed data in PermitC. Changing from invalidates the signature (different digest). Cannot drain another user's tokens with a different user's signature.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Dust-loop extraction: 100+ tiny swaps leak value per iteration
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule:2208 enforces exact balance check: balanceInBefore + amountIn == balanceInAfter. No per-swap leakage possible under this strict equality invariant.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Forged hook caller: call hook directly with fake pool identity
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All hook functions (beforeSwap, afterSwap, validateAddLiquidity, validatePoolCreation) require _requireCallerIsAMM(). validateHandlerOrder is view-only (no state changes). Registry functions require _requireCallerIsRegistry(). Forge tests confirm all revert for non-AMM/non-registry callers.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Storage-slot collision: deploy facet that writes to another facet's storage slot
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Diamond proxy uses fixed storage slot (0x9A1D) for AppStorage. Facet installation is admin-only (diamond cut). External contracts (handlers, hooks) have separate storage. No collision vector for external attackers.

theft_theses.thesis: Forge permit with arbitrary feeOnTop (unsigned field) to drain extra tokens beyond signed limitAmount
Exploit settings sync gap between registry and hook to bypass token restrictions
Deploy ERC-1271 universal signer contract to forge permits for arbitrary from addresses
